# 1001 Dapp Lego Blocks

This is the compact routing file for agents building with 1001-native dapp blocks. Use it to choose the right block first, then read the linked guide for the normal setup path.

The guides cover the basics agents need to start correctly. They are not exhaustive API references. When an exact component prop, contract method, or package export matters, inspect the source repo before inventing details.

Before building a full app, skim [`agent-checklist.md`](agent-checklist.md). If product goal, style direction, wallet UX, chains, contracts, metadata format, or infrastructure ownership are unclear and would change the result, ask the prompter.

Default path for a Nuxt/Vue EVM dapp:

1. Start with `@1001-digital/layers.evm`.
2. Add dapp-query only when reads need fallback, cache, or live updates.
3. Add the metadata stack for IPFS/IPNS/Arweave/token URI normalization.
4. Add indexing only when the app needs its own event-derived data.
5. Add contract intelligence, auth, contracts, or IPFS infra only when the product actually calls for them.

## Nuxt/Vue EVM App Foundation

- Guide: [`blocks/layers.md`](blocks/layers.md)
- Source: <https://github.com/1001-digital/layers>
- Packages: `@1001-digital/layers.evm`, `@1001-digital/layers.base`, `@1001-digital/components.evm`, `@1001-digital/components`, `@1001-digital/styles`
- Use for: Nuxt app shell, wallet connection, EVM account/profile UI, transaction flows, SIWE UI, base components, and shared CSS tokens.
- Start with: `pnpm add @1001-digital/layers.evm`

## Resilient App Data

- Guide: [`blocks/data.md`](blocks/data.md)
- Source: <https://github.com/1001-digital/dapp-query>
- Packages: `@1001-digital/dapp-query-core`, `@1001-digital/dapp-query-vue`
- Use for: one query interface over indexed data, RPC fallback, HTTP sources, cache, and live updates.

## Dweb And NFT Metadata

- Guide: [`blocks/metadata.md`](blocks/metadata.md)
- Sources: <https://github.com/1001-digital/dweb-fetch>, <https://github.com/1001-digital/normalize-dweb-url>, <https://github.com/1001-digital/resolve-metadata>
- Packages: `@1001-digital/dweb-fetch`, `@1001-digital/normalize-dweb-url`, `@1001-digital/resolve-metadata`
- Use for: `ipfs://`, `ipns://`, `ar://`, gateway URLs, CIDs, `eip155:` references, token metadata, and contract metadata.

## Event Indexing

- Guide: [`blocks/indexing.md`](blocks/indexing.md)
- Sources: <https://github.com/1001-digital/simple-indexer>, <https://github.com/1001-digital/ponder-artifacts>, <https://github.com/1001-digital/ponder-ens>
- Packages: `@1001-digital/simple-indexer`, `@1001-digital/ponder-artifacts`, `@1001-digital/ponder-ens`
- Use for: small owned event indexes, browser/server stores, and Ponder-side artifact or ENS caches.

## NFT Contracts

- Guide: [`blocks/contracts.md`](blocks/contracts.md)
- Sources: <https://github.com/1001-digital/erc721-extensions>, <https://github.com/1001-digital/check-address>
- Packages: `@1001-digital/erc721-extensions`, `@1001-digital/check-address`
- Use for: OpenZeppelin-based NFT extension modules and address type checks.

## Contract Intelligence

- Guide: [`blocks/contract-intelligence.md`](blocks/contract-intelligence.md)
- Sources: <https://github.com/1001-digital/proxies>, <https://github.com/1001-digital/natspec>
- Packages: `@1001-digital/proxies`, `@1001-digital/natspec`
- Use for: proxy/diamond/clone/beacon detection and verified-contract NatSpec.

## Wallets And Auth

- Guide: [`blocks/wallet-auth.md`](blocks/wallet-auth.md)
- Sources: <https://github.com/1001-digital/wagmi-in-app-wallet>, <https://github.com/1001-digital/adonis-siwe>
- Packages: `@1001-digital/wagmi-in-app-wallet`, `@1001-digital/adonis-siwe`
- Use for: local in-app wagmi wallets and SIWE sessions in AdonisJS backends.

## IPFS Infrastructure

- Guide: [`blocks/infra.md`](blocks/infra.md)
- Source: <https://github.com/1001-digital/ipfs.server>
- Use for: running owned Kubo/IPFS gateway, pinning, and admin infrastructure.
